status: Frozen before scoring; evaluation authorization pending
question: Do fixed equal-architecture probability ensembles of the saved full-provider temporal models improve the adopted two-seed GRU on the exposed external development cohort?

scope.learned_component_holdout: All H/A, D and normalization components exclude the evaluation provider in the inherited original folds.

latest_main_baseline.probability_hash_policy: Historical latest-main probability hashes are descriptive because independent inference replay found up to 1.4e-6 runtime drift. The pooled GRU output must equal the arithmetic mean of current-inventory seed arrays exactly; decoded hashes and metrics must match all 45 current-main report rows.

cohort.provider_weights: Equal providers; mean replicate within match, then mean matches within provider.
cohort.native_frame_population: Keep every native frame through decode; retain X in labels and let the official scorer exclude unknown labels.

arrays.probability_dtype: All frozen member arrays must be float64; ensemble arithmetic preserves this dtype.
arrays.native_masks: Preserve cached observation masks and nonfinite coordinate masks byte-for-byte; identity hashes are frozen per view.
arrays.temporal_breaks: supervised.model_periods with native period and timestamp discontinuities; no cross-break decoding.

recipe_policy.weighting: Equal architectures within recipe; for pooled mode average each architecture seed pair first, then average architectures.
recipe_policy.averaging_expression: 0.5 * (p_seed_2026 + p_seed_2027) within each architecture for pooled mode; arithmetic mean over architectures; no fitted weights, calibration, thresholds or decoder changes.
recipe_policy.ranking: Unrounded equal-provider clean spell F1; macro F1 only for exact spell ties.
recipe_policy.singleseed_modes: Same-seed modes are diagnostic only; they have no additional eligibility rule.
recipe_policy.composite: Diagnostic only; it does not change eligibility or ranking.

parity.standalone_gru_seed_controls: Exactly reproduce original 50 single-seed metrics, native probabilities and decoded predictions over clean, feed_like and composite.
parity.latest_main_gru_controls: For seed2026, seed2027 and pooled GRU, require decoded prediction byte hashes and exact metric parity with all 45 latest-main clean/feed-like reference rows.
parity.pooled_gru_probability: Must equal the arithmetic mean of current-inventory GRU seed arrays exactly. Historical latest-main probability hashes are recorded for comparison but not required to match because archived runtime replay showed up to 1.4e-6 drift.
parity.baseline_members: Use the original report artifacts for GRU, BiLSTM, Transformer and TCN at seeds 2026/2027.

metric_contract.additional: Class precision/recall/F1, D boundaries, short-spell recall, false possessions and fragmentation.
metric_contract.summarize: Replicates within match, matches within provider, equal provider mean.
metric_contract.ranking: Official mean spell F1; macro F1 exact tie-break only; 70/30 is descriptive.

adoption: No automatic promotion. Any adoption requires a separate explicit user decision and baseline provenance update.
